title: Grateful Dead Live at Augusta Civic Center on 1984-10-11
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (no Dolby) > Audiophile 2496 >  Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC.
source: FOB AUD: Sennhesier MD-441's > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell UD-XLII 90's,  no Dolby. Mics on seven-foot stood, angled up at stacks, approx 25  feet from the stage, in the center.

ai_review.summary: A tight 1984 show captured on an audience tape with great balance and clear sound.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the performance as tight and energetic, noting that Jerry’s playing retained a spooky edge despite his health issues. The audience recording is highlighted for its excellent balance and overall clarity, making it one of the better crowd‑sourced tapes from this era.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed positive reviews (4★ and 5★) emphasize a strong show and high‑quality audience recording, yielding an above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great sound and balance for an audience tape; clear, tight mix with no noted major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently tight performance throughout the concert, reflecting a well‑rehearsed tour band.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His playing is described as spooky yet strong despite declining health.
